Enable multi-language detection and inspect every ISO 639-3 code that clears the confidence threshold.

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="text/markdown", uri="https://example.com/markdown/comprehensive.md")
    config = ExtractionConfig(language_detection={"detect_multiple": True, "enabled": True, "min_confidence": 0.3})
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].detected_languages)

asyncio.run(main())
```
